title: Forgeling Safety Training
text: Mandatory safety training for all new hires. Please finish it before touching any equipment. (Too late? Finish it anyway.)
goal_text: Win a battle against a wild Forgeling.
how: Wild Forgelings live in cable tangles, like the ones on Route 1. In battle, pick EXECUTE, then a move. Bring the foe's Uptime to zero to win.
resolved: HR: Training complete. Your certificate has been emailed to you as a 40 MB attachment.

title: Asset Intake
text: Every Forgeling on the network needs an owner on file. Please quarantine one wild Forgeling and register it to yourself.
how: Weaken it first. Then pick INVENTORY and use a Thumb Drive from QUARANTINE KEYS. The lower its Uptime, the better your odds.
resolved: HR: Asset registered. Please don't name it after a coworker.

title: Break Room Orientation
text: Learn where the coffee is. This is the most important training you will receive.
goal_text: Use a Coffee on a tired Forgeling.
how: Coffee restores Uptime. Outside battle, open BAG on your phone. In battle, pick INVENTORY.
resolved: HR: Orientation complete. The coffee machine is now your problem too.

title: What is the 3-2-1 rule?
text: There's a sticky note on the old server rack at the Help Desk that just says 3-2-1. Is it a password? A countdown? Should we be worried? Nobody here remembers.
goal_text: Check the sticky note on the old server at the Help Desk.
how: The old rack is in the back corner of the Help Desk in Onboarding Town.
resolved: Accounting: Thanks! We added '3-2-1' to office trivia night. Nobody knows the answer there either.

title: Printer prints blank pages
text: Honey, my printer prints one blank page every morning at 6:00. Exactly 6:00:00, I checked. Can you look at it when you're home? Not urgent. (It's a little urgent.)
how: It's on the kitchen table. You know what to try first.
resolved: Mom: You're a lifesaver! While you're here, what's my email password again?
